name: scroll-sequence
title: 滚动分步 Scroll Sequence
description: 固定区块并用滚动进度逐步切换内部内容。

props.name: children
props.description: Steps displayed one at a time in the pinned viewport.

props.name: stepLength
props.description: Scroll distance per transition, in viewport-height units.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to observe instead of the page.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Called when the active step changes.

props.name: viewportClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the pinned viewport.

props.name: stepClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the active step wrapper.

usage: `ScrollSequence` 把每个直接子元素视为一个步骤，在固定视口中根据滚动进度切换。它适合 feature 分步演示、流程解释和一个主体视觉配合多段说明的场景。
events: `onStepChange(index)` 在活动步骤改变时触发，可用于同步外部导航、媒体时间点或分析事件。不要在回调中反向修改滚动位置，以免造成循环更新。
